key_insight: Direct interpolation followed by constraint optimization enables minimally diffusive ALE remapping while enforcing global conservation and physical bounds.
engineering_relevance: The approach supports high-order hydrodynamics simulations with large Lagrangian mesh displacements while preserving sharp features and conserving volume, mass, momentum, and total energy.
method: Transfer fields by direct physical-space interpolation using parallel, GPU-capable routines.
Restore global conservation through optimization while preserving physical bounds.
Remap arbitrary-order finite element fields and integration-point quantities without intermediate projection.
evidence_signal: The method is evaluated on standard 2D and 3D remap benchmarks and full ALE hydrodynamics simulations; the abstract reports no quantitative performance metrics.
watch_item: The computational cost and parallel scalability of the conservation-restoring optimization require assessment for large simulations.
paper_title: Remap for ALE Hydrodynamics via Direct Interpolation and Constraint Optimization
